findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Починим ноутбук сегодня от 40 минут — диагностик" → 4 lines (14 words, 42px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: Hero headline is 14 words ("Починим ноутбук сегодня от 40 минут — диагностика бесплатно "). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 11 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "4 783 проверенных отзыва" above "Отзывы и награды"; "Решаем любую проблему в день обращения" above "Что мы чиним и настраиваем"; "Фиксируем сумму до начала ремонта" above "Сколько стоит ремонт ноутбука"; "4 формата в СПб и ЛО" above "Способы ремонта и карта"; "Уникальный формат «Ленремонта» в СПб" above "Мобильная мастерская у вашего дома"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 12 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "4 783 проверенных отзыва", "Решаем любую проблему в день обращения", "Фиксируем сумму до начала ремонта", "4 формата в СПб и ЛО").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ★
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 12 gradient fill(s): div.hero-stage-gradient → linear-gradient(rgba(7, 19, 38, 0.1) 0%, rgba(7, 19, 38, 0.32) 52%, rgba(7, 19, 38, 0.88) 100%) | div.wwf-media-overlay → linear-gradient(rgba(7, 19, 38, 0.08) 0%, rgba(7, 19, 38, 0.88) 100%) | div.wwf-media-overlay → linear-gradient(rgba(7, 19, 38, 0.08) 0%, rgba(7, 19, 38, 0.88) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 50 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.hero-video-stage → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 0px 12px 28px -8px | button.btn-primary-gold → rgba(255, 210, 0, 0.35) 0px 8px 20px -4px | div.award-doc-thumb → rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08) 0px 2px 5px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 40 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.b2b-top-strip 1440px | header.site-header 1440px | div.hero-messengers-block 640px | div.brands-top-bar 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 40 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 12 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "★★★★★" 2.1:1 (#f59e0b on #ffffff); "★★★★★" 2.1:1 (#f59e0b on #ffffff); "★★★★★" 2.1:1 (#f59e0b on #ffffff); "★★★★★" 2.1:1 (#f59e0b on #ffffff)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13.5px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 3 picture(s) on the page (3 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: 3 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 152 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 42px (2.9vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 727px of nothing between: "Что мы чиним и настраиваем"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: The h1 is 12px ("Ремонт ноутбуков на дому или в сервисном центре в ").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (180px, 195px, 400px, 216px, 741px, 551px, 903px); the three most used hold only 59% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Мобильная мастерская у вашего дома" (screen 6, 100% hidden); "Гарантии и личная ответственность" (screen 8, 50% hidden); "Узнайте точную стоимость ремонта до выезда масте" (screen 12, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled (plus 1 playing video).
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
